info.title: MentorAPI
info.description:
REST API bridge for WinMentor DocImpServer COM interface v1.2.0

All endpoints except /api/health require API Key via header X-API-Key or query parameter api_key.

Most data endpoints require a firma+luna to be selected first via POST /api/firme/select.

Audit complet campuri: https://erp.malinco.ro/mentorapi/audit
